_meta.about: Loot decided by hand, next to data/loot_wiki.json. That file is generated (data/build_loot_wiki.py) from the wiki, which has no page for these creatures' drops, so their rows live here rather than in it. by_type is rolled by server/mobs.loot_table exactly like a loot_wiki.json row -- one roll per row, valuables first, at most mobs.MAX_DROPS kept -- and names its item by type id, since the linker ties the emerald and the ingot to no type at all; a row at chance mobs.SURE (1.0) is no roll but a certainty, and lies in the bag outside that cap (mobs.roll_table). items are the numbers of those items, laid over the designed frame by server/items.py the way data/heal_manual.json is (same keys, frame shape unchanged; a data/items_wiki.json record, should one appear, wins), and drop_on_death, which server/combat.drops_on_death reads here before the wiki. Keys starting with _ never reach the wire.
_meta.decided: 2026-09-25, owner («Песок и изумруды»): the Nubian mine's marauders, [1] Слабый Мародёр 836 and [2] Мародёр 837, drop gold sand and emeralds. They stand in the mine's files and nowhere else (612, 1011, 1217 and the unused copies 767, 1248; no spawn substitute maps to them), so nothing else in the world drops either. Chances DESIGNED: gold sand 0.50 from both (the owner raised it from 0.20/0.30 the same day: «подними шанс песка до 50%»), an ordinary row; the emerald 0.10 from both, a valuable one. 2026-09-26, owner («давай добавим лут шахтерам: бритву и наручные часы и еще сломанные часы, вероятность выпадения 20-30 процентов»): the same marauders also roll, as ordinary rows, Сломанные часы 6919 and Бритва 6926 at 0.30 and Наручные часы 6932 at 0.35 -- under mobs.MAX_DROPS about 0.28, 0.23 and 0.21 a kill. Then («давай еще золотой портсигар и золотой зуб») Золотой зуб 6950 and Золотой портсигар 6953 as valuables at 0.05 each. The sand and the emeralds fall off a dead player like any loot (the owner, 2026-09-25: «любой лут должен падать в том числе из шахты», against the game's hint that the mine's emeralds could not be lost), and the way out of the mine takes neither («Нет, пусть выносят»). 2026-09-25, owner («давай чтобы у босса в нубийке выпадал слиток золото и сделай квест, чтобы его можно было сдать и получить на баланс», then «и слиток в 5 голд»): the Nubian valley's one boss, [5] Лидер Новые колонисты 2103 (Лагерь бандитов, location 34, where it keeps the boss hours of server/bosses.py), carries one ingot of 5 ounces of gold (4796 New_Gold_Ingot_5) on every kill, chance 1.0, and Джеррах in the Западный поселок pays 5 ounces for it (data/quests.json 10). It falls off a dead player like any loot («любой лут должен падать»): it is loot, not gold-bought gear. 2026-09-26, for the Nubian valley's quests (the owner's «давай готовь квесты все»): rows of the tier «Квестовый», the wiki's own word, for what those quests send the player to take off a creature -- the courier's letter (17), the four gun parts and the medicaments off the raiders of «Грабители» (14, 15), the medicaments, matches and the grindstone off the New Colonists (250, 251), the leader's notes (2103) and the rat king (1019). Such a row rolls only while somebody who brought the creature down has a quest open that asks for the thing and does not yet have as many as it asks (server/mobs.py QUEST_TIER, quests.wanted_things), the original's «loot only while the quest is open»: nobody else finds a quest's litter in a bag, and a thing with no price or with the quest flag, which no other row may drop, may drop here. Holders RECOVERED where the original's texts or the quests' lavabook records name them, chances DESIGNED. The same day, for the valley's market, farm and mine quests (the third batch): the old chip Доктор Гофус asks for off the New Colonists (250, 251), and the antelope's meat and fillet the village asks for off the antelopes (12). A quest row drops only while its quest is open; one the player sells while it is (the matches, 84 afro at a stall) is loot like any other, about a third more than the colonists' 67 afro a kill: accepted, DESIGNED (counting the bank too would not stop a sale).
_meta.fields: by_type: mob type id -> rows {type, tier ('Обычный' or 'Ценный', as in loot_wiki.json, or 'Квестовый': rolled only for a quest that asks for the thing, on its own and outside the cap), chance; 1.0 is certain and outside the cap}. items: type id -> ss_si_simple_obj fields as in server/items.py (cost in afro, g_cost in hundredths of G, weight in grams, max_count the most one stack holds), plus drop_on_death (1 can fall off a corpse, 0 never).

4796._designed: the price in afro: the article's 5 G at the game's one rate, laid by server/items.py GOLD_INGOTS from progression.GOLD_TO_AFRO_RATE, which wins over the cost here: 20 000 is that price at the first rate of 4000 (the rate is 50 000 since 2026-09-28, which makes it 250 000), written down so that the price counts as a written one (combat._price_written; the name's _Gold_ would otherwise make it a gold thing), and no g_cost. Priced in gold alone it would be one of the owner's gold things (combat.gold_item), which never fall off a body, and mobs.droppable keeps anything without an afro price out of a corpse's bag. A trader pays 70 per cent of it (inventory.SMOD), 175 000 afro at 50 000, against Джеррах's 5 ounces of gold, which is the whole 250 000 at that rate, and Мортимер's cashing, 4.95 ounces: the quest is always the better deal, which is the point. No stall sells the ingot (Мортимер sells nothing here, data/npcs.json stock 1188; data/trader_stock_wiki.json lists it for nobody, no designed stall holds it), and none should: sold for afro it would turn afro into gold. The stack of 50 is the frame's: the article gives none
